requirements.scope:
jmlx relies on the direct CC BY-SA 4.0 grant for Juffa's covered expression and
the existing MIT grant for Apple/MLX contributions. Its owner interprets the
section 2(a)(5)(A) offer as continuing for Juffa's expression retained in these
adaptations, with (B) providing an additional offer. The adapter-license
condition in (B) remains the unresolved counterargument to this interpretation.
No CC adapter's license is identified. MIT is not presented as one.

The scoped CC identification concerns Juffa's covered expression in the three
reviewed functions and their corresponding compiled forms. It does not assert
an MIT-only license for Juffa's expression, or place other MLX functions,
the entire combined binaries, or jmlx Java code under CC merely because they
are distributed together. Those contributions retain their applicable terms.
Downstream recipients must retain the applicable notices and license terms;
jmlx imposes no additional terms or technological measures restricting the
exercise of the rights granted for the covered material.
